name: SpotlightGradient
description: A dark dot or line grid lit by a two-tone radial spotlight that follows the pointer with frame-rate-independent easing, brightening the grid beneath it, and drifts along a slow Lissajous path when the pointer leaves.
a11yNotes: Grid, spotlight and vignette layers are aria-hidden with pointer-events: none, so content remains interactive. The loop stops off-screen; speed 0 freezes the idle drift (pointer following still works); prefers-reduced-motion renders a static spotlight with no tracking or drift.

propsApi.name: gridOpacity
propsApi.description: Base grid opacity (0–1); the grid brightens under the spotlight.

propsApi.name: speed
propsApi.description: Idle auto-drift speed multiplier (0 freezes the drift).

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
